In your own words, how is rotating the forearm different from rotating the upper arm at the shoulder?

With the elbow bent, pronation/supination turns the palm down/up by rotating the forearm. Shoulder medial/lateral rotation turns the upper arm around its long axis; the bent forearm swings toward/away from the body. The moving segment, not just the hand’s location, identifies the action.
